units.source_text: 我们兄弟间关系并不是那么好，小时候经常打架，最后被打哭的总是年幼的我。

en.t: My brother and I were not especially close; when we were children we often fought, and in the end it was always I, the younger one, who was beaten until I cried.

units.source_text: 上大学后学的专业不同，也完全是我们性格的差异造成的。

en.t: Even the fact that we chose different fields of study after entering university was entirely due to the difference in our temperaments.

units.source_text: 上了大学后，特别是接触先生之后，我远远观察哥哥，总觉得他是个很现实的人。

en.t: After I entered university, and especially after I came into contact with Sensei, I watched my brother from a distance and always felt that he was a very practical sort of person.

units.source_text: 我难得见到哥哥，相隔又那么遥远，因此，无论是时间还是距离，哥哥总是离我很远。

en.t: I seldom saw my brother, and we were separated by such a great distance, so in both time and space he was always far away from me.

units.source_text: 然而这次久别重逢，天天生活在一起，却不知从哪儿涌出了一股兄弟之情，当然现在的特殊境况也是一个重要原因。

en.t: Yet this time, meeting again after a long separation and living together every day, a feeling of brotherly affection somehow welled up in us; of course, our present circumstances were also an important reason.

units.source_text: 就这样，在我们兄弟俩共同的父亲命悬一线的枕边，哥哥和我握手交好了。

en.t: And so, at the bedside of the father we shared, whose life was hanging by a thread, my brother and I shook hands and made peace.

units.source_text: “你以后打算干什么？”哥哥问我。

en.t: "What do you plan to do from now on?" my brother asked me.

units.source_text: 我却答非所问地反问他：“咱家的财产到底怎么处理？”

en.t: Instead of answering, I asked him a question that missed the point: "What is going to be done with our family's property?"

units.source_text: 到现在，爸一次也没提过。

en.t: Father has not mentioned it even once up to now.

units.source_text: 不过，说是财产，其实换成钱的话，也没有多少吧。”

en.t: Still, though we call it property, if it were turned into money, I doubt it would amount to very much."

units.source_text: 而母亲到底是母亲，还惦记着先生的回信呢。

en.t: Mother, being Mother, was still worrying about whether Sensei would reply.

units.source_text: 总忘不了叮问我：“还没来信吗？”

en.t: She never forgot to press me, asking, "Has no letter come yet?"
